name: refusal
description: Out-of-domain questions the corpus cannot answer. The system must refuse rather than answer from the model's training data. Nearest-neighbour search always returns chunks, so the model is handed irrelevant context and has to decide to decline.

questions.question: What is the melting point of aluminum?
Who won the 2022 FIFA World Cup?
How do I bake sourdough bread at home?
What is the capital city of Mongolia?
